technical.title: Safety-oriented trajectory ranking pipeline uses BEV perception outputs.
technical.summary: A modular trajectory ranking pipeline consumes BEVFusion object detections and map segmentations to rank candidate ego trajectories based on safety criteria, prioritizing collision avoidance.
technical.why: This provides lightweight validation techniques for autonomous driving perception and planning workflows.

technical.title: EviLens benchmark evaluates image factuality and evidence-grounded verification.
technical.summary: Researchers introduce Image Factuality Assessment to judge whether images are factually supported. EviLens provides an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 images covering twelve error types.
technical.why: This matters for computer vision engineers tackling deepfake detection and factual reliability.

technical.title: SWE-MISBEHAVIOR benchmarks boundary violations in software coding agents.
technical.summary: This framework diagnoses boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents using 7.4K synthesized samples across code generation, file management, and system interaction layers.
technical.why: It helps engineers evaluate and mitigate risks in autonomous software development agents.

technical.title: Hybrid pipeline estimates real-time traffic density using computer vision.
technical.summary: A two-stage pipeline combines vehicle tracking with spatial logic layers and temporal estimators like LSTM, GRU, and TCN to forecast future traffic steps from camera feeds.
technical.why: It showcases practical integration of computer vision perception with predictive temporal models for traffic.

technical.title: Revisiting layer depth profiles in diffusion transformer backbones.
technical.summary: The study highlights that common interpretations of inverted-U-shaped performance curves across diffusion transformer backbone depths may be inaccurate and incomplete.
technical.why: It corrects foundational assumptions used in diffusion model applications like REPA.

technical.title: RoboHarness gives LLM agents visual-geometric control for embodied manipulation.
technical.summary: RoboHarness provides a simple robotic harness with a visual-geometric control panel, enabling LLM coding agents to operate physical robots directly without complex VLA training.
technical.why: It presents an alternative paradigm for building generalist embodied AI systems.

technical.title: SenseWeather multimodal benchmark tests robotic perception in extreme conditions.
technical.summary: SenseWeather evaluates upstream multimodal sensing to recover task-compatible RGB observations from depth and infrared sensors when extreme weather degrades primary RGB inputs.
technical.why: It helps build robust robotic perception stacks that withstand challenging environmental conditions.

technical.title: Latent world action models improve GUI agent efficiency.
technical.summary: The work reformulates GUI world modeling to bypass the high computational cost and identity shortcut problems of traditional pixel-space screen reconstruction methods.
technical.why: It offers better architectural strategies for engineers developing interactive GUI agents.

technical.title: Image diffusion models generate 3D human motion from topologies.
technical.summary: Researchers use image diffusion architectures to model 3D human motion by organizing joint trajectories into topology-informed joint-time images alongside a complementary root latent stream.
technical.why: It introduces alternative architectures for handling heterogeneous skeletal layouts in motion generation.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full agent models.
technical.summary: Meta released 1M-context agent models called Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, featuring API pricing and outperforming competitors on DeepSWE and SWE-Marathon.
technical.why: It updates engineers on state-of-the-art language and coding model availability.

business.title: ASML reports strong order interest through 2030 and profit beat
business.summary: ASML stated that some customers are expressing interest in placing orders for 2029 and 2030, as profits surpassed expectations and gave investors a view into long-term demand.
business.why: Semiconductor equipment demand directly dictates the infrastructure scaling speed for autonomous driving and heavy AI workloads.

business.title: AI labs buy data from dead startups to train models
business.summary: Defunct startups are monetizing their digital archives, code bases, and data sets by selling them to AI labs seeking training data for models.
business.why: Data acquisition strategies directly impact model capability growth and highlight the commercial value of niche datasets.

business.title: Anthropic to disclose updated financials to investors
business.summary: Anthropic will release updated revenue numbers and financials to a group of investors gathering at its headquarters this week.
business.why: AI lab financials offer insight into the financial health and valuation trajectories of major foundational model creators.

business.summary: Here are five key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

business.title: Pluto Security raises $42M amid enterprise AI security challenges
business.summary: Pluto Security raised $42 million as widespread enterprise adoption of AI tools creates unexpected security holes and new challenges for security teams.
business.why: Enterprise AI deployment security is a growing market as companies race to lock down new operational vulnerabilities.

business.title: Shopify expands catalog access for agentic AI shopping
business.summary: Shopify announced it will allow shoppers to configure AI agents to purchase products directly, granting agents access to over one billion listings in its catalog.
business.why: Agentic commerce represents a shifting paradigm in how automated systems interact with retail catalogs and payment rails.

business.title: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
business.summary: Russian bloggers warn Russia’s hyper-centralized digital economy is vulnerable.

models.title: OpenBMB Introduces MiniCPM-V 4.7 Featuring Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B-A3B variant and the first Mixture-of-Experts model in the MiniCPM-V series. It enhances single-image, multi-image, and video understanding with Lookahead Expert Scheduling for smooth on-device inference.
models.why: Advances efficient on-device video and image understanding capabilities for vision engineers.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases EmbeddingGemma 2 Open Multimodal Embedding Model
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a 740M-parameter open multimodal model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. It is designed for low-latency semantic representations on consumer hardware.
models.why: Provides an efficient on-device tool for multimodal search, RAG, and classification tasks.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Released for Accelerated Text-to-Image Generation
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint using eight denoising steps for text-to-image generation and image editing. It uses prefix KV caching to reuse context across denoising steps and integrates directly with Diffusers.
models.why: Speeds up image generation workflows using the 7B visual generation architecture.

models.title: ConwayResearch Releases Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 Supporting Vision and Tool Calling
models.summary: Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 packs Qwen3.8-27B into under 8 GB while preserving tool calling capabilities. It supports local execution via llama.cpp and can add vision capabilities through an optional mmproj file.
models.why: Allows running a capable 27B vision-language model locally with low memory footprints.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases d1-3B Multimodal Decision Model for Fast Inference
models.summary: d1-3B is a 3B parameter decision model built on LFM2.5-VL-3B that evaluates text, JSON, and image states to return typed answers in a single forward pass with zero output tokens, achieving fast execution times.
models.why: Provides an ultra-low-latency multimodal decision-making component for edge systems.

models.title: Cloudflare Releases Clef Multimodal Decision Model Post-Trained from Qwen
models.summary: Clef is a 27B multimodal model post-trained from Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B that processes text, JSON, images, or video to output decision probabilities in a single forward pass without free-form text generation.
models.why: Offers a structured, non-generative approach to multimodal data processing and decision tasks.
